input.prompt: American comic book panel, painted with modelled 3D light and then inked: a tall 1950s strip-chart recorder cabinet in polished brass and black enamel seen straight on in a laboratory at night, at the top a brass housing with a row of round dials and one red lamp, below it a long tall sheet of plain warm amber paper unrolling straight down out of the housing and filling the middle of the frame from one fifth to the bottom, the paper completely blank with no lines, brass rollers at the sides, a green glass desk lamp casting warm light from the upper left, dark shelves with glass bottles behind, bold black ink contours, Ben-Day halftone dots only inside the shadows.
